import React from 'react' import '../style/tour-detail.css' import { Container, Row, Col, Form, ListGroup } from 'reactstrap' import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom' import tourData from '../assets/data/tours' import caculateAvgRating from '../utils/avgRating' const TourDetails = () => { const { id } = useParams() const tour = tourData.find(tour => tour.id === id) const { photo, title, desc, price, address, reviews, city, distance, maxGroupSize } = tour const { totalRating, avgRating } = caculateAvgRating(reviews) return <>

{title}

{caculateAvgRating === 0 ? null : avgRating} {totalRating === 0 ? ( "Chưa có đánh giá" ) : ( ({reviews.length}) )} {address}
{city} {price} {maxGroupSize}
Mô tả

{desc}

{/*tour reviews*/}

Reviews ({reviews?.length} reviews)
} export default TourDetails
